item.title: Ravens Back Out Of Blockbuster Maxx Crosby Trade After Failed Physical
item.description: The Baltimore Ravens have backed out of a reported trade for Raiders star Maxx Crosby after he failed his physical. Baltimore will retain its 2026 and 2027 first round draft picks.

item.title: Ravens Restructure Lamar Jackson Deal, Free Up $40M In Cap Space
item.description: The Baltimore Ravens restructured Lamar Jackson’s contract to free up nearly $40 million in salary cap space as the team works to finalize Trey Hendrickson’s deal and pursue a long term extension with their franchise quarterback.
